This record is not a corrected fixture registry, correction map, exact-byte owner-ratification receipt, concurrence acceptance, or product authorization.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Backup verification error projections
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.closure: All five backup verification leaves have one exact existing 53-code projection; no reviewer or implementer selects or shares a different code.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Global-event insertion and startup projections
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.insertion_disposition: Roll back the entire transaction with zero committed mutation, zero event publication, no retry or overwrite, and the exact selected content-free error projection.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.startup_disposition: Block the authority and write gate with GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT; do not repair, renumber, skip, alias, or publish over corrupt history.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.duplicate_event_id_disposition: For a generated duplicate event_id, use one entropy call, zero mutation, no retry, no overwrite, and GKOS_P6_IDENTITY_COLLISION.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Reference physical drift and restart cursor precedence
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.physical_drift_disposition: After a live opaque-reference resolver hit, failed physical requalification projects authenticated-redacted GKOS_P6_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND with zero replacement-object access, zero result, zero effect, and zero mutation.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.restart_cursor_disposition: The existing CURSOR_STALE projection GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY wins before any dead, absent, stale, or invalid reference lookup and requires fresh live reference rediscovery. No durable resolver, raw path, new table, new operation, or continuation exception is permitted.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Restore locator conflict projections
common_disposition: no deletion of the preexisting or raced object
preserve exact nonsecret recovery evidence and staged-plan state
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.closure: The initial clean preexisting-target conflict and the later no-replace identity/existence race are separate deterministic leaves with distinct exact projections.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Restart-race deterministic cut outcomes
precommit_stale_cuts: request admitted but final gate not passed
final gate entered or passed without a committed effect boundary
effect prepared with no terminal committed effect
uncommitted mutation or restore anchor intent without the source-controlled committed durable point
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.precommit_decision: On restart, persist request state stale and project GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY with zero result, zero externally committed effect, zero success activity, and no guessed completion.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.later_cut_decision: Cuts at or after a source-controlled committed durable point use the already-ratified deterministic recovery or replay rule for that exact cut. They must be separate leaves and may return or finish only the one result, effect, event, anchor, or replay already proven by durable evidence, without duplicate publication or timing-dependent alternatives.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.closure: One restart fixture ID identifies one durable cut and one outcome. A single ID may not permit committed-or-stale, recovered-or-aborted, or other alternatives.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Named recovery semantics and corrected accounting
decisions: RESTORE-OWNER-001 through RESTORE-OWNER-009 retain their original exact D0 meanings and must not be reassigned.
A valid staged restore plan, temp, locator, and credential automatically resume the same bound operation without secret re-reveal.
Abort occurs only through the separately authenticated owner abort operation and its distinct deterministic leaves; authority.status may report eligibility but does not abort.

BOOTSTRAP-LOCATOR-ROLLBACK-001 freezes transaction rollback after durable same-locator OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED publication, followed by exact same-locator retry with zero replacement identity, locator, or secret.
Newly separated publication, crash, physical-negative, error-projection, and restart leaves use distinct additional canonical IDs.

ratified_q7_q13_decisions.title: Acyclic evidence and concurrence sequence
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.decision: This V4 is the necessary immutable projection-resolution receipt after the exact V3 parent. Next prepare a new exhaustive registry evidence descendant; then prepare a new correction-map evidence descendant that binds only existing immutable parents; then obtain a separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification receipt for the completed descendant coordinate; only after that exact-hash ratification may fresh C1 migration and security concurrence restart.
required_order: separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification receipt
fresh C2 authority/concurrency after all C1 accept
fresh C3 Full-contract plus Lite-conformance after C2 accepts
separate successor-F1 correction authorization request only after all five accept
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.acyclic_rule: Every descendant binds only exact immutable parents that already exist. This V4 intentionally does not identify, predict, reserve, or bind any future descendant hash or byte length. Any byte change invalidates dependent receipts and requires regeneration of only later descendants plus fresh exact-byte owner ratification.
ratified_q7_q13_decisions.c1_restart_rule: C1 restart is not authorized by this V4. It becomes eligible only after a separate owner receipt ratifies the exact hashes and byte lengths of the completed new registry and correction-map descendants.

resolved_v3_projection_classes.resolution: Q7 selects GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT for integrity, foreign-key, and pragma failures and GKOS_P6_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH for byte-length and manifest-digest mismatches.
Q8 selects GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT for global-event coordinate mismatch during insertion.
Q8 selects GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT for duplicate global_event_seq during insertion.
Q8 selects GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT for kind-to-table mismatch during insertion.
Q9 selects authenticated-redacted GKOS_P6_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for live-reference post-resolution physical drift.
Q10 selects GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT for an initially preexisting clean final locator and GKOS_P6_MIGRATION_RECOVERY_REQUIRED for a post-qualification identity or existence race.
